summary.summary: On 2026-01-25 at 01:49 UTC the auth-service generated a HIGH‑severity credential‑stuffing alert. In a one‑hour window 37 distinct usernames failed login attempts from 35 different sources, far above the learned baseline (z‑score 36.7). This represents a sharp spike compared with normal login failure rates.
summary.likely_trigger: A credential‑stuffing attack (ATT&CK T1110.004) targeting auth-service caused the surge in failed logins.
summary.suggested_next_check: Review the auth-service logs for the offending source IPs and usernames, and verify that rate‑limiting and account lockout controls are functioning as expected.
